decisions.text: Postings are immutable once committed; a correction is a reversing entry written by `src/posting.rs`

gotchas.text: The account ids in `tests/fixtures/accounts.json` are shared by every ledger test; add accounts, never renumber them

decisions.text: Balances are derived from postings on read in `src/balance.rs`; nothing stores a running balance
Account codes are unique per book, enforced by the index in `migrations/0007_accounts.sql`
Keep every `mod.rs` to re-exports only; logic lives in named files
Amounts are i64 minor units with an ISO 4217 code; never floats

gotchas.text: rust_decimal is only for display rounding; it never reaches storage

decisions.text: Booking dates are chrono NaiveDate in the book's timezone, never a timestamp

gotchas.text: Month-end close runs at local midnight of the book, not UTC

decisions.text: Library errors are thiserror enums; anyhow only in the CLI binary

gotchas.text: LedgerError::Unbalanced carries both sides, so logs never need a second query

decisions.text: Storage is Postgres through sqlx with compile-time checked queries

gotchas.text: SQLX_OFFLINE=true is required in CI because the runner has no database

decisions.text: Bank statement imports are idempotent on the statement line hash

gotchas.text: CAMT.053 files repeat the opening balance on every page

decisions.text: The HTTP API is axum with one router per bounded context

gotchas.text: tower-http's TimeoutLayer must sit outside the auth layer

decisions.text: Reports read balances through a materialized view refreshed nightly

gotchas.text: REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY needs a unique index

decisions.text: Report rows stream as CSV; nothing builds a whole report in memory

gotchas.text: Excel opens the CSV export correctly only with a UTF-8 BOM

decisions.text: Reversal entries link to the posting they reverse by its id

gotchas.text: A reversal of a reversal is refused; post a new entry instead
